allVisibleCapturedMeaning: true = every quest VISIBLE to this profile was captured, completed, active, failed, or listed-but-locked, across every tab the trader shows. It does NOT mean every quest the trader has: anything still gated behind an unfinished quest or an unreached loyalty level is not on screen and is therefore not here. No trader in this collection is complete in the absolute sense.
allVisibleCapturedNote: Fence has NO other tabs, no loyalty levels, only the essential group. So these five are the whole of Fence.

profile.note: Confirmed PvE, and independently by the data: two of these cards are '[PVE ZONE]' variants, and those ids exist ONLY in tarkov.dev's pve task list. The regular list carries the same quests under '[PVP ZONE]' with different ids.
profile.factionNote: USEC. DETERMINED FROM THE COLLECTION ITSELF, not something written down at capture time. Four quests are faction-exclusive with no counterpart id: Road Closed (USEC), Green Corridor (BEAR), Our Own Land (BEAR) and Counteraction (USEC). "Road Closed" is ACTIVE on this profile, and the wiki says outright that it is "only obtainable by USEC PMCs" with Green Corridor as its BEAR counterpart. Both BEAR-only quests are absent from Prapor's list, which was captured in full. A BEAR profile could not show Road Closed and would have to show the other two, so the reading is unambiguous.

reading: Read off the in-game quest screen. Objective text is verbatim, including the (Optional) prefix and the [PVE ZONE] tag in the title.

quests.cardShowsRequirementsNotObjectives: A LOCKED quest shows a TASK UNLOCK REQUIREMENTS panel in place of its objectives, the game's own statement of what gates it, and the single most valuable thing this collection can capture. The empty `objectives` array is therefore CORRECT and not a gap: a locked quest prints no objectives at all. Confirmed on 2026-08-11 that the seven requirements below are the WHOLE list, not a scrolled fragment, which is consistent, because seven is exactly the number of traders that have a loyalty level to reach. Fence, Ref, the BTR Driver and the Lightkeeper have no LL4 to require.
quests.profileLoyaltySnapshot: The ticks double as a snapshot of my loyalty on 2026-08-10: LL4 reached with Therapist, Prapor, Mechanic, Jaeger and Skier; not yet with Peacekeeper or Ragman.
